name: ESC_RESPONSIBLE_USERS
description: Status of all responsible groups and users.

columns.name: ESCALATION_ID
columns.description: The unique identifier (.1 item) for the subject name record.

columns.name: LINE
columns.description: The line number for the information associated with this record. Multiple pieces of information can be associated with this record.

columns.name: USER_ID
columns.description: The IDs of the users responsible for the escalation

columns.name: USER_ID_NAME
columns.description: The name of the user record. This name may be hidden.

columns.name: RESP_USER_STATUS_C_NAME
columns.description: Instant there was a change event for the escalation.

columns.name: PROVIDERTEAM_ID
columns.description: The PCT IDs of the responsible provider teams

columns.name: CALL_ORDER
columns.description: The most recently attempted call order for the provider team

columns.name: ROLE_TRTMNT_TEAM_REL_C_NAME
columns.description: The most recently attempted role for the provider team

columns.name: RESPONSIBLE_REASON_C_NAME
columns.description: The reason that the user is listed as responsible for the request.

columns.name: REASON_USER_ID
columns.description: Contains the EMP ID of the user who caused this user to be listed as responsible

columns.name: REASON_USER_ID_NAME
columns.description: The name of the user record. This name may be hidden.

columns.name: REASON_PROVIDERTEAM_ID
columns.description: Contains the PCT ID of the On-Call team this user is a member of that caused them to become responsible
